definitions.gloss: large sum of money; high price; expensive
definitions.explanation: An amount of money that is notably large. Often used as a no-adjective ({高額|こうがく}の/{高額|こうがく}な) to modify nouns, describing things that cost or are worth a lot.

examples.japanese: {高額|こうがく}な{買|か}い{物|もの}をした。
{高額|こうがく}{医療費|いりょうひ}の{払|はら}い{戻|もど}し{制度|せいど}を{利用|りよう}した。
examples.english: I used the high-cost medical expense reimbursement system.

examples.japanese: このマンションは{駅|えき}に{近|ちか}いため{高額|こうがく}だが、{利便性|りべんせい}を{考|かんが}えると{妥当|だとう}な{価格|かかく}だと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: This apartment is expensive because it's close to the station, but I think the price is reasonable considering the convenience.

notes:
Compound of {高|こう} (high) + {額|がく} (amount). Functions as both a noun and a no-/na-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高額|こうがく}な{商品|しょうひん} (expensive product)
- {高額|こうがく}{医療費|いりょうひ} (high medical expenses)
- {高額|こうがく}{納税者|のうぜいしゃ} (high taxpayer)
- {高額|こうがく}{当選|とうせん} (winning a large amount, as in lottery)
- {高額|こうがく}{請求|せいきゅう} (large bill/charge)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{高価|こうか} (expensive, costly) describes the value or quality of goods, while {高額|こうがく} focuses on the monetary amount. {高値|たかね} refers specifically to market prices.
